scope: offline builds only; no programmer/UART/DRAM access; physical DDR behaviour unverified; STA is internal-constrained, not external DDR timing
tool: Gowin V1.9.11.03 Education (81398), gw_sh, no programming
memdd3_vo_note: differs from frozen 4d37c875...; MemDDR3.ipc and gwmc_param.v hashes equal the recorded ones; only the Created Time header is believed to differ (base FS reproduces be42c604 apart from its Created Time comment).

base.description: baseline: unchanged be42c604 sources, rebuilt for tool/netlist reproducibility

cs0.description: (b) ddr_cs fixed to 0 like the Sipeed sample; IP O_ddr_cs_n left open

rst.description: (c) no extra 1ms reset hold after PLL lock: controller_reset_n = raw_reset_n && pll_lock

refwait.description: (d) wait 60000 USER cycles (~0.74ms @81MHz, >200 tREFI) after calibration instead of 256

pace.description: (e) sample-like pacing: commands/write data issued only when a free-running 8-bit counter is 0 (one per 256 USER cycles), as the Sipeed tester does with work_counter==0

norst.description: (g) IP ddr_rst output left open like the Sipeed sample (ip_user_reset tied 0); the IP no longer resets the USER logic

readfirst.description: (h) BIST starts with the verify (read) phase instead of the fill (write) phase: tests whether the scheduler serves READ commands (mismatch errors are expected and irrelevant)

clk400_notap.description: (a2) clk400 on the UNTAPPED regenerated MemDDR3.vo: scheduler observation (024f deep words: FIFO pointers, send_wr, pre_info_valid, issue_*) is NOT available (taps tied 0) because issue_write/issue_read net names do not follow in the new netlist; native BIST counters and calibration flags remain

sampleip.description: (i) bisect: OUR user logic (mem_bist/mailbox/link, 398/100 MHz reporting, PLL 398.25MHz) on the Sipeed sample IP (GowinSynthesis 1.9.8.05 DDR3_Memory_Interface_Top, 400MHz, 14-bit row); cs fixed 0 like the sample; no scheduler taps (deep_taps tied 0). DIAGNOSTIC: blanket-async clock groups like the sample SDC

clk400_asyncsdc.description: (a3) clk400_notap RTL/IP unchanged, but with the sample-style blanket-async SDC (mem_bist_sampleip.sdc) instead of the guarded SDC: tests whether calibration failure comes from constraint-driven placement/routing rather than the IP/PLL. Tap-less like clk400_notap

clk400dp.description: (a4) clk400_notap RTL with the IP regenerated with Debug_Parameter_Enable (P1 101 = DLL CODESCAL, P2 6 = DQ IODELAY, P3/P4 40): reproduces the sample netlist CODESCAL/DQ-IODELAY, not its cmd/addr/CK IODELAY(40) nor SCAL_EN. Needs MEM_IP_TAG=clk400dp. Tap-less

sampleip_map.description: (i2) sampleip with the BIST address placed for the sample IP row14 layout {bank3,row14(MSB 0),col10} (APP_ROW_PAD=1), so bank/row/capacity tests address the right bank bits; everything else as sampleip

sampleip_map_t1.description: (i3) sampleip_map with the timing-oriented BIST (PIPELINE=1: registered START inputs and range check, 3-stage read compare). Same behaviour, START takes effect one cycle later, DONE after the last beat is accounted. Targets the -0.53ns setup violations at USER 99.5625MHz; the sample IP internal path is untouched

sampleip_map_t2.description: (i4) sampleip_map_t1 plus PIPELINE=2: no reset_n term in the native-enable gating (busy is asynchronously cleared) and a registered copy of calibrated for fault/settle/start decisions (calibration loss detected one cycle later; enables still use the raw input)

sampleip_map_t3.description: (i5) sampleip_map_t2 plus PIPELINE=3: registered calibrated also in the native-enable gating and both timeout comparators (wait, 64-bit total) registered one cycle ahead with identical firing cycle

sampleip_map_t4.description: (i6) sampleip_map_t3 plus PIPELINE=4: native enables are a 3-input AND of the IP ready flops, a registered want and !cancel (one idle cycle per beat), to remove the IP ready -> enable -> IP FIFO flag combinational path that stays at -0.164 ns in t3

clk400x_dp000.description: (a5) untapped clk400 IP regenerated with Debug P1=101 (DLL CODESCAL), P2=0 (DQ IODELAY 0) - the values the generator itself uses for the official 1:2/200MHz reference. Needs MEM_IP_TAG=xdp000

clk400x_dp1116.description: (a6) untapped clk400 IP with Debug P1=111, P2=6: the generator default CODESCAL with the sample DQ IODELAY. Needs MEM_IP_TAG=xdp1116

clk400x_drvhigh.description: (a7) untapped clk400 IP with OUTPUT_DRV HIGH (RZQ/7=34 ohm); IPUG281 suggests changing it when initialisation fails. Needs MEM_IP_TAG=xdrvhigh

clk400x_scoped.description: (a8) clk400_notap RTL/IP with the guarded SDC plus the SCOPED exceptions E1-E4 proposed in docs/DDR3_clk400_SDCŒÀ’è—áŠOˆÄ_2026-11-04.md (IP-internal/reset sys27->user100 paths false-pathed for setup/recovery only, held_op given the held-bundle max-delay contract). Needs MEM_IP_TAG=clk400; verifies the proposal by an official STA run
